card.name: Dust Tornado
card.officialText: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

behavior: Normal Trap only from a face-down backrow set in a previous turn, during own priority or an explicit response chain
target picker returns UIDs only; targets may be face-up or face-down Spell/Trap cards in the opponent backrow or separate Field Zone
TargetBinding tracks zone/epoch; a target that leaves, returns, changes controller or changes zone cannot be destroyed
destroyed target and source Trap go to their physical owners' shared Graveyards
optional Spell/Trap from active representative hand is set face-down after destruction; its setTurn is the current turn
if negated, target invalid, or destruction prevented, the optional Set does not occur
source leaving its backrow frees a zone for the optional Set; field zone remains separate
activationId replay protection persists through JSON; inventory identities are conserved

limitations: Adapter isolado e não certificado; sem integração ao resolver v9, catálogo, metadata, allowlist ou comandos.
A UI de escolha privada e a projeção pública de cartas Set dependem da integração central; o adapter retorna somente UIDs para o picker.
Testes offline; sem gateway/guild Discord real.
